title: threads-resolve.json — thread-resolve receipt
description: The receipt `threads resolve` writes beside threads.json: the host, head, and timestamp of the mutation, the ids it closed, and the candidates it skipped with a machine-readable reason. A real run writes one host resolve call per id in resolved[]; a dry run writes no receipt and carries the plan in the envelope only. GitHub and GitLab carry the mutation; a host without a resolve endpoint refuses before this document is written.

schema_version.description: Receipt format version; only "1" is read.

provider.description: The host whose resolve call closed the threads.

pr.description: Pull request number the receipt belongs to.

head_sha.description: The head the thread feed was read at when the run selected its candidates.

dry_run.description: True only on a dry run; a real receipt is always false.

resolved.description: Host thread ids the run closed, in selection order.

skipped.description: Candidates the run left open, each with the reason it was skipped.

skip.description: One skipped candidate: the host thread id and the machine-readable reason (already-resolved, no-finding-link, finding-not-addressed).

id.description: Host thread id the selection considered.

reason.description: Why the thread stayed open: already-resolved, no-finding-link (no finding marker), or finding-not-addressed (the local store does not mark the linked finding addressed).
